label: PF Backlog 641
title: Fix gate enforcement gaps: bookkeeping tier must run completion gates; approval must consider all decisions
body: Found while verifying EDP-21: data-only completion PRs skip gate2-completion (bookkeeping tier), and gate_predicates.approval returns STALE on the first stale decision instead of trying older valid ones.

decisions.note: Gate 1: close gate-enforcement gaps found verifying EDP-21.
Gate 2: bookkeeping-tier completion gates + decision selection fixed (d959b0b7a055); EDP-21 retro-validated.

brief.problem: Found while verifying EDP-21: data-only completion PRs skip gate2-completion (bookkeeping tier), and gate_predicates.approval returns STALE on the first stale decision instead of trying older valid ones.
brief.what_adds: Fix gate enforcement gaps: bookkeeping tier must run completion gates; approval must consider all decisions
brief.why: Found while verifying EDP-21: data-only completion PRs skip gate2-completion (bookkeeping tier), and gate_predicates.approval returns STALE on the first stale decision instead of trying older valid ones.

objective: Close the two hard-gate enforcement gaps found while verifying EDP-21.
acceptance_criteria: precheck bookkeeping tier runs gate2-completion and delivery-completeness so a data-only completion PR is still gated.

gate_predicates.approval evaluates every gate decision (newest first) and returns STALE_APPROVAL only when a gate decision exists but none matches the current evidence sha+digest; NO_GATE_APPROVAL otherwise.
EDP-21 is retroactively validated: a valid Gate 1 decision (digest bound) is recorded and gate2-completion passes against the commit before its completion.
Unit tests cover the multi-decision selection and the bookkeeping-tier wiring; precheck PASS.
in_scope: Fix gate enforcement gaps: bookkeeping tier must run completion gates; approval must consider all decisions
approach: Fix gate enforcement gaps: bookkeeping tier must run completion gates; approval must consider all decisions
verification: Objective achieved: Fix gate enforcement gaps: bookkeeping tier must run completion gates; approval must consider all decisions

analysis.implementation_strategy: Extend `core/merge_gate.py` / gate predicate layer (`gate_predicates.approval`) so approval iterates over ALL decisions and returns STALE only if no valid (non-stale) decision exists; add a completion-gate invocation path for bookkeeping-tier (data-only) PRs by routing them through gate2-completion in `core/merge_gate.py`/`core/code_quality_gate.py`. Reuse existing `/api/v1/engineering/pidl/gate` and gate config modules.
conflict_findings: BI-PF-0237 may concurrently touch gate_predicates.approval — sequence or coordinate to avoid duplicate writers.
duplication_findings: BI-PF-0237 covers approval truth/fail-closed HIL decisions — overlap on approval semantics; reuse its decision model rather than new logic.
No existing backlog item covers bookkeeping-tier gate skip specifically.
analysis.rationale: Two precise, bounded defects in existing gate code; fix is a MODIFY of existing predicate + routing logic, reusing the pidl gate API and gate configs. Approval must remain fail-closed (BI-PF-0237) while fixing the stale short-circuit.
assumptions: gate_predicates.approval lives in a Python module (edit-to-shipped-Python allowed)
Decision records carry ordering/timestamp sufficient to pick newest valid
Bookkeeping tier is declared in existing config/hardware-tiers or ci-cd-gates config
risks: Changing approval to try older decisions could weaken fail-closed intent — must preserve HIL/MAJOR fail-closed rules
Bookkeeping gates may add latency to data-only PRs
Stale-decision iteration could mask genuinely revoked approvals
evidence: Item body cites verified defect found while checking EDP-21
Candidate modules core/merge_gate.py and core/code_quality_gate.py own gate logic
API /api/v1/engineering/pidl/gate already exists for predicate evaluation
missing_info: Exact definition of 'bookkeeping/data-only' tier and where it is declared (which config key)
Whether stale decisions should be logged/metric-ed as a signal
Desired precedence when both a stale MAJOR and a newer valid MAJOR exist
